title: Path to Success for Emerging Managers
primary_theme: Emerging manager success through conviction, community, and team cohesion
secondary_themes: Education and Asian American community support
founder_lessons: Emerging managers need conviction in their strategy and belief system because the path will not be linear.
Lean into community, mentors, trusted advisors, and peer support systems while building a firm.
Avoid teams that feel like a collection of people rather than a cohesive unit.
Treat references and strategy-team fit as decisive diligence inputs.
notable_quotes: The outperformance that you can get from newer and smaller funds today, relative to more larger established firms, can be more significant than it's been in the past.
Having a community around your firm matters
I believe that talent is equally distributed, but opportunity isn't
